## What problem does this solve?

Describe the problem from the perspective of someone writing a test —
what are you unable to do today, or what requires more ceremony than it
should?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see — an API sketch is welcome, but not required.

```csharp
// optional: a rough sketch of the API you'd want
```

## Alternatives considered

Any other way to solve this (a workaround you're using today, a different
API shape) and why it's less good than the proposal above.

## Scope check

- [ ] I checked [Concepts](https://layeredcraft.github.io/compono/concepts/)
      and the [Architecture](https://layeredcraft.github.io/compono/architecture/)
      section — this isn't already possible with an existing mechanism.
- [ ] I checked the [Roadmap](https://layeredcraft.github.io/compono/roadmap/)
      — this isn't already tracked as a planned/proposed item.

## Additional context

Anything else — links to a similar feature in another library, a real
test scenario this would simplify, etc. For anything non-trivial (a new
provider, a new package, a change to the composition engine's public
surface), expect this to start as a design conversation before any code
is written — see
[Contributing](https://layeredcraft.github.io/compono/contributing/).
